t: A small, low-cost LoRa board with a tiny screen and a battery charger.
steps: Buy the T3-S3 from the LilyGO store or Tindie. Pick the radio module and band for your country.
Screw on the LoRa antenna before you power it up. The radio can be damaged without one.
Plug it into a computer with a USB-C cable.
Flash Meshtastic with the Tlora T3s3 V1 target. Double press reset to enter download mode.
Install the Meshtastic phone app and pair with the board over Bluetooth.
Set your region and send a test message to a friend with a second node.
To write your own code, install the Arduino IDE and pick the LilyGo T3-S3 board with QSPI PSRAM.
Try a LoRa example from the LilyGo-LoRa-Series repo.
meta: Open Board. From $19.81. A few stores.
